title: PATH_PAYMENT_STRICT_SEND fails with PATH_PAYMENT_STRICT_SEND_SRC_NOT_AUTHORIZED
pattern: A transaction whose PATH_PAYMENT_STRICT_SEND operation fails at apply is still written into the closed ledger: its fee is charged, its sequence number is consumed, and nothing it did is kept. The result carries the operation's code (src_not_authorized). Sending ARQ from a trustline that holds 10 but was deauthorized.

hazards.placement: strict send from a deauthorized trustline

facts.says: No operation changed state: the operation meta is empty.
The fee is still charged: the fee source changes in fee processing.
